title: Spartan RV Chassis Connects with Community at America’s Largest RV Show
body_markdown:
For Spartan RV Chassis, the show was an opportunity to connect face-to-face with the people who make the RV lifestyle what it is.


“America’s Largest RV Show brings the entire community together, and we’re excited to be part of it. It’s a fantastic opportunity to connect with customers, build awareness around the Spartan difference and highlight the significant role the chassis plays in overall journey. It’s about delivering the confidence, support and freedom that makes Life Better on a Spartan.” — Greg Rinehart - Training and Dealer Operations Manager, Spartan RV Chassis


Our Sales Trailer and 40th Anniversary Demo Chassis on display at America’s Largest RV Show.


### **Bringing the Spartan Brand to Hershey**


The annual event brings the RV world together for several days of education, networking, product discovery, and conversations about the RV lifestyle. PRVCA notes that the show is one of only two manufacturer shows in the country, giving attendees a unique opportunity to see a broad range of new RVs and speak directly with manufacturers.


Spartan RV Chassis was proud to be part of that experience, engaging with attendees and helping them better understand the chassis that supports their journey.


For Spartan, those conversations are important. An RV is more than its floorplan, fancy finishes, or technology. The chassis is the foundation that brings everything together, playing a vital role in the driving experience, serviceability and confidence RV owners have when they head down the road or into their campsite.


That makes events like Hershey an important opportunity to share the Spartan story and build awareness around the difference a purpose-built premium chassis can make.


The Spartan team connected with local tech students during educational sessions, sharing hands-on knowledge and a look at the technology behind the chassis.


### **Investing in the Future of the RV Industry**


Spartan also welcomed students to its booth during Education Days, providing an opportunity to introduce future RV professionals to the industry and the technology behind today's motorhomes.


For an industry built around innovation, education is an important part of moving forward. Giving students the chance to see the products, people, and career opportunities within the RV industry helps build the next generation of professionals who will keep RVs moving down the road.


Spartan supported the PRVCA Silent Auction, contributing to a collection of products and experiences as part of its Gold Sponsorship. The donation package included an Oil Change and Training Class Gift Vouchers, representing $2,000 in educational value, reinforcing Spartan’s commitment to supporting knowledge and training within the RV industry.


The PRVCA Silent Auction was part of the organization's broader efforts to support the industry, while proceeds from America’s Largest RV Show help fund education and training programs for RV technicians and dealership personnel.


For more than 25 years, Spartan has been proud to support and be part of America’s Largest RV Show.


### **Celebrating More than 50 Years of RV History**


The significance of America’s Largest RV Show is rooted in decades of RV history.


PRVCA hosted its first show exclusively featuring RVs in 1970. As the event grew, it eventually moved to the Giant Center in Hershey in 2005 and officially became known as America’s Largest RV Show® in 2008.


For more than 25 years, Spartan RV Chassis has been proud to be part of an event that brings the RV industry and community together to experience the full breadth of the RV lifestyle in one place.


Being part of that history is about more than displaying a brand. It’s about being present where the RV community gathers and sharing what makes a Spartan-powered motorhome different.


Discover 40 years of Spartan RV Chassis and see what makes life better on a Spartan.
